title: Make the portable suite pass on this VM so it can join validation
objective: npm run test:portable failed here at adoption on 2026-09-20 in 5 seconds: the integration harness started its Next server, then tests/portable-integration.mjs reported a sub-suite exit code of 1. The likely cause is the stale staged build under the ignored .sites-runtime/portable-build directory rather than the source, but that is unproven. Until it passes here it is not configured in project.json; node tests/acceptance.mjs and node tests/refinement.mjs, which need the dev server on localhost:5173, stay in docs/VALIDATION.md's manual ladder likewise.
acceptance: npm run test:portable passes from this checkout, with the cause recorded in docs/VALIDATION.md.
The command is added to project.json's focused and full tiers only after that pass.
non_goals: No change to what the suites test.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.

handoff.next_action: Run npm run test:portable after removing the stale .sites-runtime/portable-build staging, and compare.
